mapper.select:
select PRIN_AMT*-1 from WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T1 inner join WFL_PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T2 on T1.TRADE_ID = T2. TRADE_ID inner join WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD T3 on T1.TRADE_ID = T3.TRADE_ID
T2.PA_BUSS_TYPE = #{repoType} AND T1.VDATE <= to_date(#{sysDate},'yyyy-mm-dd') AND T1.MDATE >= to_date(#{sysDate},'yyyy-mm-dd') AND T1.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID = #{manageId} AND T3.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId}

select PRIN_AMT * -1 from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T1 inner join PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T2 on T1.TRADE_ID = T2.TRADE_ID inner join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD T3 on T1.TRADE_ID = T2.TRADE_ID
T2.PA_BUSS_TYPE = #{repoType} AND T1.VDATE <= to_date(#{sysDate},'yyyy-mm-dd') AND T1.MDATE >= to_date(#{sysDate},'yyyy-mm-dd') AND T1.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID = #{manageId} AND T3.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId}

SELECT sum(NVL(INTOTALPRINAMT.AMOUNT, 0) * 100 * NVL(FSCR.SCALE, 0))- AVG(NVL(STANDARDPLEDGE.AMOUNT, 0)) PRIN_AMT FROM (SELECT TSF.PORTFOLIO_ID, TSF.SEC_ACCT_ID, TSFD.FINPROD_ID, SUM(DECODE(TSF.PS, '01', 1, '02', -1) * NVL(TSFD.AMT, 0)) AMOUNT FROM TRD_STASEC_FLOW TSF LEFT JOIN TRD_STASEC_FLOW_DETAIL TSFD ON TSFD.SEQNO = TSF.SEQNO AND TSFD.BRANCH = #{BRANCH_0, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE TSF.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId} AND TSF.CDATE <= TO_DATE(#{vdate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND TSF.SEC_ACCT_ID = #{manageId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} GROUP BY TSF.PORTFOLIO_ID, TSF.SEC_ACCT_ID, TSFD.FINPROD_ID) INTOTALPRINAMT LEFT JOIN (SELECT TPDA.PORTFOLIO_ID, TPD.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID SEC_ACCT_ID, SUM(DECODE(TPD.PS, 'T23', NVL(TPD.PRIN_AMT, 0) * -1, NVL(TPD.PRIN_AMT, 0))) AMOUNT FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL TPD LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE FPT ON FPT.FINPROD_ID = TPD.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD TPDA ON TPDA.TRADE_ID = TPD.TRADE_ID WHERE FPT.TYPE_6 = 'H02' AND TPD.TRADE_STATUS = '01' AND TPD.PS IN ('T23', 'T01') AND TPD.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F02' AND TPDA.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId} AND TPD.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID = #{manageId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND TPD.TRADE_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{vdate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND TPD.CCY = 'CNY' GROUP BY TPDA.PORTFOLIO_ID, TPD.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID) STANDARDPLEDGE ON STANDARDPLEDGE.SEC_ACCT_ID = INTOTALPRINAMT.SEC_ACCT_ID AND STANDARDPLEDGE.PORTFOLIO_ID = INTOTALPRINAMT.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_STDSEC_CONVERSE_RADIO FSCR ON FSCR.FINPROD_ID = INTOTALPRINAMT.FINPROD_ID AND FSCR.BRANCH = #{BRANCH_0, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND FSCR.VDATE <= TO_DATE(#{vdate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM FIN_STDSEC_CONVERSE_RADIO FSCRINNER WHERE FSCRINNER.FINPROD_ID = FSCR.FINPROD_ID AND FSCRINNER.BRANCH = #{BRANCH_0, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND FSCRINNER.VDATE <= TO_DATE(#{vdate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND FSCRINNER.VDATE > FSCR.VDATE)

SELECT sum(NVL(INTOTALPRINAMT.AMOUNT, 0) * 100 * NVL(FSCR.SCALE, 0)) + AVG(NVL(STANDARDPLEDGE.AMOUNT, 0)) PRIN_AMT FROM (SELECT TSF.PORTFOLIO_ID, TSF.SEC_ACCT_ID, TSFD.FINPROD_ID, SUM(DECODE(TSF.PS, '01', 1, '02', -1) * NVL(TSFD.AMT, 0)) AMOUNT FROM TRD_STASEC_FLOW TSF LEFT JOIN TRD_STASEC_FLOW_DETAIL TSFD ON TSFD.SEQNO = TSF.SEQNO AND TSFD.BRANCH = #{BRANCH_0, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE TSF.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId} AND TSF.CDATE <= TO_DATE(#{vdate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND TSF.SEC_ACCT_ID = #{manageId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} GROUP BY TSF.PORTFOLIO_ID, TSF.SEC_ACCT_ID, TSFD.FINPROD_ID UNION SELECT TSF.PORTFOLIO_ID, TSF.SEC_ACCT_ID, TSFD.FINPROD_ID, SUM(DECODE(TSF.PS, 'T68', 1, 'T69', -1) * NVL(TSFD.AMT, 0)) AMOUNT FROM TRD_TEMP_STASEC_FLOW TSF LEFT JOIN TRD_TEMP_STASEC_FLOW_DETAIL TSFD ON TSFD.SEQNO = TSF.SEQNO AND TSFD.BRANCH = #{BRANCH_0, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE TSF.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId} AND TSF.CDATE <= TO_DATE(#{vdate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND TSF.SEC_ACCT_ID = #{manageId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} GROUP BY TSF.PORTFOLIO_ID, TSF.SEC_ACCT_ID, TSFD.FINPROD_ID ) INTOTALPRINAMT LEFT JOIN (SELECT ESP.PORTFOLIO_ID, ESP.SEC_ACCT_ID, SUM(NVL(ESP.AMOUNT, 0)*100) AMOUNT FROM ETR_SEC_POSITION ESP WHERE ESP.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId} AND ESP.SEC_ACCT_ID = #{manageId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND ESP.CDATE <= TO_DATE(#{vdate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND ESP.FINPROD_ID='XN_PRODID999' AND ESP.CCY = #{ccy} and NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ETR_SEC_POSITION ESP1 WHERE ESP1.PORTFOLIO_ID = ESP.PORTFOLIO_ID AND ESP1.SEC_ACCT_ID = ESP.SEC_ACCT_ID AND ESP1.CDATE <= TO_DATE(#{vdate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND ESP1.CCY = ESP.CCY AND ESP.FINPROD_ID='XN_PRODID999' AND ESP1.CDATE > ESP.CDATE ) GROUP BY ESP.PORTFOLIO_ID, ESP.SEC_ACCT_ID ) STANDARDPLEDGE ON STANDARDPLEDGE.SEC_ACCT_ID = INTOTALPRINAMT.SEC_ACCT_ID AND STANDARDPLEDGE.PORTFOLIO_ID = INTOTALPRINAMT.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_STDSEC_CONVERSE_RADIO FSCR ON FSCR.FINPROD_ID = INTOTALPRINAMT.FINPROD_ID AND FSCR.BRANCH = #{BRANCH_0, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND FSCR.VDATE <= TO_DATE(#{vdate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM FIN_STDSEC_CONVERSE_RADIO FSCRINNER WHERE FSCRINNER.FINPROD_ID = FSCR.FINPROD_ID AND FSCRINNER.BRANCH = #{BRANCH_0, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND FSCRINNER.VDATE <= TO_DATE(#{vdate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND FSCRINNER.VDATE > FSCR.VDATE)
